about: Engine-semantics probes. Each is one small query whose answer Microsoft Learn does not state outright but a lab/kql rule (and the offline KqlLite interpreter) relies on. harness.py run records what the engine returned (rows or error) in results.json 'probes'; probes are not pass/fail - the rule cases are the assertions, and a probe explains a failing case.

probes.question: Is a record whose array is EMPTY kept by mv-apply when the subquery is a summarize with no by? (Learn, mv-expand: an empty array produces no record; mv-apply expands with mv-expand first.)
probes.query: datatable(k:string, a:dynamic)['empty', dynamic([]), 'one', dynamic(['x'])] | mv-apply e = a on (summarize n = count(), s = make_set(tostring(e)))
reliedOnBy: blocked-country-signin: a sign-in with ConditionalAccessPolicies == [] (comment: 'ALWAYS returns one row')
app-credential-added: the first credential on an app (OldSet == [])
pim-activation-without-auth-context: a step-up sign-in whose CA list == []

probes.question: Same, for a null dynamic (Learn, mv-expand: a null produces a single null record).
probes.query: datatable(k:string, a:dynamic)['null', dynamic(null)] | mv-apply e = a on (summarize n = count())
reliedOnBy: app-credential-added / ca-policy-changed: a modified property whose oldValue is null

probes.question: mv-apply ... to typeof(string) over an array of objects: stringified, or null? (Learn, mv-expand: 'cast-only ... elements that don't conform with the declared type become null values'.)
probes.query: print a = dynamic([{"Issuer":"https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com","Subject":"repo:x"}, "[KeyType=Password]"]) | mv-apply e = a to typeof(string) on (summarize l = make_list(e), lwn = make_list_with_nulls(e))
reliedOnBy: app-credential-added before CODE-NEEDED-2 was applied (it now converts with tostring()); kept to confirm the premise of that fix and of KqlLite's cast-only mv-apply

probes.question: Does arr[-1] (no parentheses) return the last element? (Learn, dynamic: the example is arr[(-1)].)
reliedOnBy: ad-privileged-group-change: GroupRid = split(GroupSid, '-')[-1] decides every domain Tier-0 group (512, 518, 519 ...)

probes.question: make_set over a column of arrays: one flat set, or a set of arrays?
reliedOnBy: dcsync-replication-request: RightsUsed = make_set(RightsUsed, 10) over extract_all arrays

probes.question: union isfuzzy=true with a leg that calls a function that does not exist: leg dropped, or query error?
reliedOnBy: dc-logon-outside-operator-allowlist and sod-violation-granted on a workspace without Sentinel's _GetWatchlist

probes.question: union isfuzzy=true with a leg that projects a column its source does not have (a watchlist with no items, so no watchlist columns): leg dropped, or query error?
reliedOnBy: sod-violation-granted: the planned sod_holdings watchlist before it has rows

probes.question: After a leftouter join with no match, is a right-side string column null or empty, and a datetime null?
probes.query: datatable(k:string, a:string)['1', 'x'] | join kind=leftouter (datatable(k:string, b:string, t:datetime)[]) on k | project b, b_isnull = isnull(b), b_isempty = isempty(b), t_isnull = isnull(t)
reliedOnBy: security-info-registered-risky: NoContext / RiskySignIn on a registration with no context sign-in

probes.question: has / has_any with a hyphenated GUID needle against 4662 Properties text.
probes.query: print t = '%%7688\r\n\t\t{1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2}\r\n' | extend h = t has '1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2', ha = t has_any (dynamic(['1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2', '1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2']))

probes.question: ipv4_is_in_any_range against an empty dynamic array: false or null?
probes.query: print r = ipv4_is_in_any_range('198.51.100.7', dynamic([])), r2 = ipv4_is_in_any_range('198.51.100.7', dynamic(['198.51.100.7/32']))

probes.question: coalesce on strings: is the empty string skipped?
tostring() of a modifiedProperties entry: are the keys emitted in ingestion order? (Learn, dynamic: 'Kusto doesn't attempt to preserve the order of name-to-value mappings in a property bag'.)
reliedOnBy: pim-group-member-added-outside-pim and auth-method-changed-by-admin: extract(@'Group\.ObjectID"[^}]*?newValue...') assumes displayName precedes newValue inside the serialised entry

probes.question: How the v1 REST endpoint returns dynamic values (JSON text or objects) - the harness decodes both.
probes.query: print d = dynamic({"a":1}), arr = dynamic([1, 2]), s = 'text'
